caption: The template step of the new funnel in Systeme.io: the funnel has two steps, Opt-in page and Thank You / Download Page, and the template list shows generic website templates such as Volunteer in your Community, Empowering Women & Girls Worldwide, Protect our Wildlife and Elite Legal Advocacy, each with a Use template button. The page editor with the headline replaced by Get the free Test Co e-book (font size 63, text headline panel on the left, Popups, Settings and History at the top). The Save button is greyed out while the change is saved.
